I give up.

Why: the statement needs the probability as an explicit function of r, then a strict minimum over [0, 8].

- The math: the chord PQ meets Δ iff |r·cos φ − 9·cos ψ| ≤ 1, where φ = (θ₁+θ₂)/2 and ψ = (θ₁−θ₂)/2. So ProbIntersect r = avg over φ of g(r·cos φ), with g(a) = measure of {ψ : |a − 9 cos ψ| ≤ 1}.
- g is strictly increasing in |a| on [0, 8], so ProbIntersect r > ProbIntersect 0 for every r in (0, 8]. The minimizer set is {0}, matching `putnam_2024_a5_solution`.
- Formalizing this needs the change of variables from (s, t) to angles, Fubini, the arccos form of the measure of g, and a strict monotonicity argument. None of that is available as compiled-only Mathlib with no lemma search, so I could not produce a compiling proof in this session.
